purpose: Lock a cohesive ground/material authoring vocabulary before G-7A rebuilds streets, lots, dock edges, and transitions.

material_families.use: cargo work edge between dock and street
roads climbing from harbor to civic/residential districts
building bases, stoops, shop frontage, tavern threshold
rear lane, cooperage, barrels, delivery edges
upper home yards and soft lot boundaries
harbor shoreline and under-pier water interface

cohesion_rules: No large translucent road rectangles in normal gameplay proof.
Every building base must touch a lot material family.
Every road must connect to at least two destinations.
Every dock path must have a water/wood/stone transition.
Ground patches may be irregular, but not disconnected editor-looking slabs.
Props cannot be used to hide ground seams.

future_spikes.reason: Possible generated ground textures after material taxonomy is locked.
Possible structured replacement for hand-drawn ground patches after G-7A.
